svg.title: Midnight Agent AI Wallet — how a private agent allowance works
svg.desc: The owner funds a shielded vault and sets a private policy. An agent requests a payment. A Compact contract checks authority, recipient, asset, expiry, per-payment limit and remaining allowance. A valid proof moves shielded coins; a finalized network receipt confirms the result. The browser demo simulates this flow; the public Preview demo uses real test-network transactions.

g.aria-label: A shielded vault checks each request before any coins can move.
Set an expiry for the agent.
Owner can pause, revoke or withdraw.
Reuse the ID to check the result.
The agent does not get the owner's keys.
Explore the rules. Simulated balances and receipts.
Use Preview, a wallet and a prover. Test tokens only.
Privacy is bounded: the runner and prover see witnesses; the network sees calls, timing and commitments.
